notes.title: PRE-RELEASE DEVELOPMENT ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are excited to announce that we are in the mid-late stages of the development. Soon expect new screesnhots, new store page art and a new trailer coming up.

If you're interested in the game, please consider adding it to your Wishlist. Your support means a lot to us. The game is inspired by Chained Together and Only Up!. Feel free to drop any ideas and suggestions in the Community hub.
